1.web: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
1.asv: The king’s heart is in the hand of Jehovah as the watercourses: He turneth it whithersoever he will.

2.web: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
2.asv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; But Jehovah weigheth the hearts.

3.web: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
3.asv: To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to Jehovah than sacrifice.

4.web: A high look, and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
4.asv: A high look, and a proud heart, Eventhe lamp of the wicked, is sin.

5.web: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
5.asv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; But every one that is hastyhastethonly to want.

6.web: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
6.asv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue Is a vapor driven to and fro by them that seek death.

7.web: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
7.asv: The violence of the wicked shall sweep them away, Because they refuse to do justice.

8.web: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
8.asv: The way of him that is laden with guilt is exceeding crooked; But as for the pure, his work is right.

9.web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than to share a house with a contentious woman.
9.asv: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, Than with a contentious woman in a wide house.

10.web: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
10.asv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: His neighbor findeth no favor in his eyes.

11.web: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
11.asv: When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise; And when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

12.web: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
12.asv: The righteous man considereth the house of the wicked, Howthe wicked are overthrown to their ruin.

13.web: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
13.asv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, He also shall cry, but shall not be heard.

14.web: A gift in secret pacifies anger; and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
14.asv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger; And a present in the bosom, strong wrath.

15.web: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
15.asv: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

16.web: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
16.asv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding Shall rest in the assembly of the dead.

17.web: He who loves pleasure shall be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
17.asv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: He that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

18.web: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; the treacherous for the upright.
18.asv: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; And the treacherouscomethin the stead of the upright.

19.web: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
19.asv: It is better to dwell in a desert land, Than with a contentious and fretful woman.

20.web: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
20.asv: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; But a foolish man swalloweth it up.

21.web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
21.asv: He that followeth after righteousness and kindness Findeth life, righteousness, and honor.

22.web: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
22.asv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, And bringeth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

23.web: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
23.asv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue Keepeth his soul from troubles.

24.web: The proud and haughty man, “scoffer” is his name; he works in the arrogance of pride.
24.asv: The proud and haughty man, scoffer is his name; He worketh in the arrogance of pride.

25.web: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
25.asv: The desire of the sluggard killeth him; For his hands refuse to labor.

26.web: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
26.asv: There is that coveteth greedily all the day long; But the righteous giveth and withholdeth not.

27.web: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
27.asv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; How much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind!

28.web: A false witness will perish, and a man who listens speaks to eternity.
28.asv: A false witness shall perish; But the man that heareth shall speak so as to endure.

29.web: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
29.asv: A wicked man hardeneth his face; But as for the upright, he establisheth his ways.

30.web: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
30.asv: There is no wisdom nor understanding Nor counsel against Jehovah.

31.web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
31.asv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; But victory is of Jehovah.
